root_idea.summary: The root denotes benefit and utility, in contrast to harm: what helps bring about good or fulfills a desired purpose.
root_idea.development: The basic opposition to harm develops into beneficial effect, advantage, and useful means. Its derived patterns express causing benefit, benefiting from something, and seeking benefit.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Form I perfect-tense dictionary citation form.
Displayed under the supported singular dictionary citation form مَنْفَعَة; the Quranic group supplies its broken plural مَنَافِع.
Distinct Quran-attested abstract noun retained as its own public form.

senses.definition: To benefit, profit, avail, or be useful to someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: An active transitive use in which a person or thing is the beneficiary or object of benefit; Quranic contexts may affirm or deny that something will provide benefit.

quranic_forms.public_pos_label: Noun · plural form in the Quran

senses.definition: Benefits, advantages, utilities, or useful means by which good or a desired purpose is attained.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences are the broken plural مَنَافِع of مَنْفَعَة and can denote concrete or abstract forms of usefulness.

senses.definition: Benefit or useful good; something that helps attain good, as opposed to harm.
senses.usage_conditions: An abstract noun for beneficial effect, advantage, or usefulness; Quranic usage also occurs in contexts that deny the efficacy or availability of benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a medicine or remedy, to be beneficial for or against an ailment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction in which the remedy is beneficial as treatment for, or protection against, a disease or similar ailment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause benefit to come to someone.
To benefit or profit by something; to make use of it, have its use, or enjoy it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII usage with بِـ introducing the thing from which benefit or use is obtained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand that something benefit him or be useful to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X usage expressing the seeking or demanding of benefit or usefulness.
